copy.title: Comp line
copy.body: Gallant meets Sea of Tranquility. The first brings the gothic, paranormal pull of a house that is not what it seems. The second brings the speculative, time-bending literary register. Both are recent Breakout titles, and Qloo shows fans of both share a taste for fiction, fantasy and audiobook.
copy.hint: The one-line "X meets Y" that opens every pitch.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Query letter comps
copy.body: THE LANTERN ARCHIVE [word count] is a standalone speculative novel for readers of Gallant and Sea of Tranquility. Like Gallant, it works in gothic space, with a building that holds secrets. Like Sea of Tranquility, it treats time and loss as literary material rather than plot machinery. It also sits close to Under the Whispering Door, which handles grief with warmth, and Ordinary Monsters (The Talents Trilogy, #1), an adult historical fantasy with horror edges. All four were published in 2022 or 2021 and show strong affinity with the book's touchstones: Piranesi, The Starless Sea, The Book of Lost Things (The Book of Lost Things, #1) and The Ocean at the End of the Lane. Gallant, Sea of Tranquility and Under the Whispering Door are Breakout in size, so the readership is current and active.
copy.hint: The comparables paragraph for a query letter or proposal.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Who it's for
copy.body: The audience reads speculative fiction that is narratively dense and gothic, and its taste descriptors include time, fate, storytelling and recovery. Qloo shows a male skew of 0.19 against a female skew of -0.19, and ages are fairly even, with a slight over-index at 35–44 (+0.02) and 55+ (+0.03). These readers also favor story-led audio fiction such as Welcome to Night Vale, The Magnus Archives and Alice Isn't Dead, and shop through Barnes & Noble, Strand Bookstore and Goodreads. Emerging markets include -area readers, Providence and Buffalo, and Spokane reads as a hidden gem. This is aggregate taste, not a forecast.

copy.title: For fans of
copy.body: For fans of Piranesi, The Starless Sea, Gallant and Sea of Tranquility: a night-shift archivist, a wing of the library that rearranges itself around grief, and someone hiding the dead there.

• Fans of Sea of Tranquility: a quiet night shift, a strange archive, and a mystery about where the dead go.
• Fans of Under the Whispering Door: grief gets a place to live, and someone has been abusing it.
